title: Negative: dimensioned sketch of domed disc, 20 ft wide by 6-8 ft high, with "Noted Shadow"
description: Landscape white-on-black negative photostat of a sketch of a domed, saucer-shaped object dimensioned "20'" wide and "6 to 8'" high. Hatching on the dome's underside is labeled "NOTED SHADOW", and a typed note below reads "(Ration approx. 3:1)". The page carries struck-through CONFIDENTIAL stamps and the signature block of a USAF 1st Lt., Intel Officer.
